_doc: SW-2 quantmac r5: Any-Other-institutions block classification + per-cell verdicts. name_verdicts holds the curated per-holder-name class (foreign/domestic) — hand-reviewed; the regexes only PROPOSE.

name_verdicts curated 2026-08-30: foreign = the Foreign-*/FII/QFI-Corporate/OCB LABEL classes, development-finance multilaterals (IFC/ADB/CDC/BII/DEG/FMO), and entities the filer itself tags (FII)/(FPI) (incl. untagged spellings of the same holder); domestic = Indian life insurers + unclaimed-suspense. Entity names with no label, no filer tag and no jurisdiction marker stay UNRESOLVED (held), never guessed.

name_verdicts extended 2026-08-30 via CROSS-REFERENCE: a holder name seen >=2 times under the filers OWN FPI/FVCI typed rows across the 16,719 cached filings (and never under a domestic row) = foreign; the mirror rule = domestic. The filers own classification elsewhere is the evidence (e.g. AMANSA 418x under FPI, MALABAR 257x, ELARA 228x).
